jobs.title: Senior ERP Consultant – Implementation & Customer Success - Field / Remote UK
jobs.description:
Implement. Improve. Challenge. Make ERP Actually Work for the Customer.

Great ERP consultants don’t just implement software – they transform how businesses work.

This is a role for an experienced ERP consultant who wants more than project delivery. You’ll stay close to the customer, own the outcome and help businesses get genuine, lasting value from their ERP system.

You’ll combine commercial insight, technical expertise and hands-on problem-solving across the entire customer journey – from discovery and implementation to go-live, optimisation and ongoing success.

Ready to own the outcome
, challenge the status quo and make ERP genuinely work for the customer? Read on
.

The Role at a Glance

Senior ERP Consultant
UK Field-Based | Extensive UK Travel & Regular Overnight Stays
£55,000 – £65,000 + Car Allowance + Benefits
Permanent | Full Time

Your Expertise:
ERP Implementation, Customer Success, Business Process Mapping, SQL, Change & Optimisation, Training, Data and Operational Systems

The Opportunity

We build ERP software that helps ambitious UK businesses run their day-to-day operations – from orders, stock, purchasing and warehouse processes to fulfilment, reporting, finance and customer service.

Customers don’t just need software configured. They need someone who can understand how their business works, guide them through change and make sure the system genuinely improves how they operate.

As a Senior ERP Consultant, you’ll work directly with both new and established customers. You’ll deliver implementations, improve existing setups, educate users, solve operational problems and make sure customers see the value of the system.

You’ll be the trusted expert on the ground – running discovery sessions, mapping business processes, challenging assumptions, configuring practical solutions, supporting go-lives and helping users build confidence.

This is a small, agile and fast-moving software business, so this isn’t a narrow “caretaker” role.

You’ll get involved beyond the traditional boundaries of implementation, helping shape how projects are delivered, how the product develops and how customers are supported.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Delivering ERP implementation projects across different industries.
• Leading optimisation, improvement and change projects within existing customer environments.
• Understanding customer workflows and translating them into practical ERP solutions.
• Running discovery, requirements gathering, process mapping, training and go-live support.
• Configuring solutions and supporting customers through implementation and adoption.
• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and day-to-day users.
• Challenging customer assumptions constructively when there’s a better way to achieve the outcome.
• Using SQL and data investigation to support configuration, troubleshooting and validation.
• Working closely with Support, Product and Development to resolve issues and improve delivery.
• Feeding customer insight back into the business to improve the product, process and customer experience.
• Helping shape how implementation and Customer Success are delivered as the business grows.

About You

This isn’t a role for someone who has simply administered an ERP platform internally. You’ll be an experienced ERP consultant who understands implementation, operational processes and what it takes to guide customers successfully through change.

You’ll bring:

• At least five years’ experience implementing, consulting on or advising around ERP systems.
• Proven experience delivering successful ERP implementations and strong customer outcomes.
• Experience improving, optimising or leading change within existing ERP customer environments.
• Strong knowledge of processes such as stock, purchasing, order management, fulfilment, finance and reporting.
• Solid SQL and technical capability, with the confidence to investigate data and get under the hood when required.
• Experience running discovery, requirements gathering and business process mapping.
• Confidence training users and working with non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge, guide and influence.
• The ability to bring structure and calm when customers are under pressure.
• A practical, proactive mindset and willingness to get involved wherever the customer or wider business needs you.
• The flexibility to travel extensively across the UK and stay away from home regularly.

What This Role Isn’t

This isn’t a desk-only ERP configuration role.

You won’t spend your working life sitting remotely and configuring tickets somebody else has scoped.

You’ll work with real businesses, real operational pressure and sometimes messy problems. You’ll need the technical confidence to investigate issues properly, alongside the commercial judgement to understand what the customer is really trying to achieve.

Equally, this isn’t purely a new implementation role. A significant part of your value will come from returning to established customers, identifying where they could be getting more from their ERP environment and leading the improvements needed to make that happen.

The Travel

This is a genuinely field-based, customer-facing position.

You’ll travel extensively across the UK to work directly with customers, including regular overnight stays away from home.

If you enjoy getting out from behind the screen, understanding customer operations first-hand and becoming their trusted ERP expert, it could be exactly what you’re looking for.

Why Join?

• £55,000 – £65,000 salary.
• Car allowance plus additional company benefits.
• Genuine ownership of customer outcomes.
• Variety across implementations, optimisation and operational problem-solving.
• Direct access to leadership within a small, agile business.
• The opportunity to influence project delivery, product development and Customer Success.
• A role where your commercial, operational and technical expertise are equally valued.
• The chance to see the real-world impact of the solutions you deliver.

Your Experience May Include
Senior ERP Consultant, ERP Implementation Consultant, ERP Software Consultant, ERP Functional Consultant, Business Systems Consultant, Implementation Consultant, ERP Application Consultant, ERP Customer Success Consultant or Senior Software Consultant.

Ready to Own the Outcome?

If you enjoy getting close to customers, understanding how their businesses really operate and turning ERP technology into measurable improvements, we’d love to meet you.

Bring your ERP expertise
, SQL capability, commercial judgement and willingness to get out there with customers – and help make sure powerful software delivers powerful results.

Application notice... We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

Good luck, Team RR.

jobs.title: Customer Success and Support Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description: Customer Success and Support Analyst at everyLIFE Technologies

Salary: £27,000 per annum, with salary reviewed on successful completion of 6-month probationary period. Plus paid on-call.

Position Type: Permanent
Location: Hybrid: Farnborough head office and Remote
Benefits: 25 days holiday, private medical cover with Vitality, life insurance, company pension scheme, Cycle-scheme, free non-fiction book scheme, earlier finish ‘Chill Friday’
Working Hours: Full time
Start date: ASAP
Reporting to: Head of Customer Experience

We are rapidly expanding our team and looking for a full-time Customer Success and Support Analyst to support our growing customer base.
The Customer Support team are a multi-disciplined, technical and customer-driven team delivering excellent service.

About the role

This is a fast-paced, customer-facing support role where you will work across multiple channels, with a strong focus on telephone-based support.
You will spend a significant portion of your time speaking directly with customers, helping them resolve issues in real time, guiding them through workflows, and ensuring they get the most value from our products. Confidence and clarity on the phone are essential.
You will:

Deliver high-quality customer support across email, in-product chat, and telephone, with phone support as a core part of the role
Confidently handle a high volume of inbound and outbound customer calls, including troubleshooting issues and guiding users step-by-step through solutions
Ensure customers receive an easy, memorable, and valued service across all touchpoints
Seek to understand how customers use our products, and proactively offer guidance to help them get the best value
Troubleshoot issues live with customers, often in real-time over the phone
Maintain an accurate record of enquiries with all relevant information within Salesforce to ensure timely and accurate resolution of issues and customer queries
Provide emergency support out of hours on a rotational basis (after initial onboarding period)
Use software tools to thoroughly investigate, test and replicate customer issues to identify causes of problems
Work with connected technology providers to effectively implement integrated solutions or solve problems affecting customers
Research and interpret application log files and user behaviour to help diagnose issues
Document and share workarounds or key steps via our Help and Support Centre and with wider customer-facing teams
Use software such as Intercom, Aircall, Confluence, Jira, Kibana, Postman and Bugfender, as well as Microsoft suite of products

You have:

Proven experience in a customer-facing role with regular telephone-based support (e.g. contact centre, service desk, or high-volume support environment)
At least 1–2 years’ experience handling customer support via telephone in a fast-paced environment
Strong verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly, control conversations, and explain technical concepts clearly over the phone
Experience handling challenging conversations and confidently de-escalating frustrated customers
The skillset to follow up with customers and deliver timely updates on tickets and cases
Experience of working in a high-performing, busy team
A logical approach, with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
Initiative to resolve customer issues and provide an exceptional service
The ability to manage a varied workload
A desire to increase your technical knowledge
Willingness to contribute ideas, innovation and team spirit

You may have:

Experience or interest in the Care industry
An inclination to keep up with developments in technology and social care
Experience using Salesforce, Intercom and Jira
An ambition to continuously grow and develop

Why join everyLIFE?

Be part of a team that is transforming the UK care industry
. If you thrive supporting customers, enjoy building relationships and making a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you!
Our mission is to create effective tools and services that release the potential of care teams.

Established in 2014, everyLIFE Technologies is a fast-growth SaaS provider primarily to the UK social care market. We exist to support care services to be the best that they can be.
We design, build, release, manage and support software and mobile applications that are crucial parts of the care being given to tens of thousands of people across the UK. We must get it right, every day!
Our ideal teammates are thoughtful, humble, curious, achievement-oriented professionals who can both zoom into the details and zoom out to embrace the big picture. We are customer-led and always aim for the highest standard. We believe in being transparent in all our dealings; acting fairly, openly, and honestly in everything we do.

Please note that we are only able to accept applicants with the right to live and work in the UK without the need for sponsorship. If you are on a visa and interested in applying for this role, please contact us for further information.

If you have any questions, or to apply with your CV, please email
hr@everylifetechnologies.com
Due to the high volume of applicants that we receive, we cannot always guarantee that you will receive a response.

jobs.title: Graduate Computational Urban Designer (G2) - Bristol
jobs.description:
See it differently - Early Careers at Arup

See it differently

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.

The Opportunity

The Graduate Computational Urban Designer would contribute across two connected workstreams in our team.

Strategic Masterplanning & Advisory:
Masterplanning and urban design studies
Research, analysis and visualisation
Development frameworks and strategic plans
Community and stakeholder engagement support
Bid and proposal support
Urban InForm:
Project deployment and set-up
Computational modelling support
Testing and quality assurance with Arup domain experts
Development of re-usable digital workflows and libraries
User support, onboarding and training materials
Production of client demonstrations and project value stories
You will be aligned but not limited to the following duties -
Masterplanning and urban design studies
Computational modelling support- specific to Arup's Urban Inform
Development of re-usable digital workflows and libraries
Production of client demonstrations and project value stories

https://www.arup.com/services/digital-solutions/inform/

Urban InForm Demo Page: https://inform.arup.com/project/51531235-4b8a-4086-9c7b-3693639f0918?view=inform&analysisId=6a8db621ee0e34b9f7daf2b8

https://arup.sharepoint.com/:p:/s/ParametricMassing/IQCRkb7STyU9R5XhQRRMoypEAYno7fhB8ZyUNq4NUJf04pM?CID=889bb523-ce08-d181-2a05-b289f9c220c4

Is this role right for you?

For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:

A Master's-level degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, such as Computer Science (including Cybersecurity), Architecture, Urban Design or Urban Planning.

Parametric and computational design: Rhino and Grasshopper Ability to build, test and maintain reusable scripts, definitions and workflows Understanding of spatial parameters, design rules, optimisation and scenario testing.
GIS, spatial data and mapping: ArcGIS, QGIS and/or FME Spatial data preparation, cleaning, geoprocessing and analysis Ability to work with site, land use, movement, environmental and socio-economic datasets.
Data analytics and visualisation: Excel, Power BI and/or similar dashboarding tools Ability to interpret datasets and translate outputs into clear project insights Basic understanding of data structures, KPIs and performance metrics Urban modelling and scenario testing: Experience supporting masterplan option testing, density studies, accessibility analysis, land-use mix, capacity studies and climate/sustainability metrics

Ability to connect design inputs with evidence-based outputs for client decision-making

Coding and scripting: Python would be particularly useful, especially for automation, data processing and linking design tools with external datasets Familiarity with APIs, notebooks or low-code/no-code workflows would be beneficial
CAD and design production: AutoCAD, Rhino and potentially Revit awareness Ability to translate between technical outputs and spatial/design drawings
Graphic communication and client-facing outputs: Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop Clear visual storytelling for reports, bids, client demonstrations and training materials
AI-supported workflows: Interest in AI-assisted design, research, coding, data interpretation and visualisation Ability to test AI-enabled workflows responsibly and document their value, risks and limitations

To Be Considered For a Graduate Opportunity, Your Application Must Include a Copy Of Your Academic Transcript And Meet The Following Criteria

Full working rights in the country of application
No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role
Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

In order for your application to be considered for this role, please upload evidence of work, for example your sample portfolio or website link. The document must be in PDF format and no larger than 20MB. Please use image compression and vector drawings where possible to keep the file size down without sacrificing quality. To upload your sample portfolio please add it within the 'supporting documents' section of your application.

Alongside your qualifications and experience, we look for the following core attributes:
Changemakers: You care about sustainable development and want to see your work make a genuine difference.
Innovative minds: You think critically, ask hard questions, and are genuinely open to new approaches.
Growth seekers: You are curious, actively seek feedback, and look for ways to keep developing.

Adaptable adventurers: You are comfortable with uncertainty and adapt readily as projects and priorities evolve.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.

Eligibility

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.

What we offer you

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.

We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Next Steps

We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact UKEarlyCareersRecruitment@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

As a Disability Confident Level 2 Employer in the UK, we will strive for one third of all our interview places to be allocated to candidates who have disclosed they are disability confident and best meet the requirements of the role.

Closing Date: Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.

new_jobs.title: Senior ERP Consultant – Implementation & Customer Success - Field / Remote UK
new_jobs.description:
Implement. Improve. Challenge. Make ERP Actually Work for the Customer.

Great ERP consultants don’t just implement software – they transform how businesses work.

This is a role for an experienced ERP consultant who wants more than project delivery. You’ll stay close to the customer, own the outcome and help businesses get genuine, lasting value from their ERP system.

You’ll combine commercial insight, technical expertise and hands-on problem-solving across the entire customer journey – from discovery and implementation to go-live, optimisation and ongoing success.

Ready to own the outcome
, challenge the status quo and make ERP genuinely work for the customer? Read on
.

The Role at a Glance

Senior ERP Consultant
UK Field-Based | Extensive UK Travel & Regular Overnight Stays
£55,000 – £65,000 + Car Allowance + Benefits
Permanent | Full Time

Your Expertise:
ERP Implementation, Customer Success, Business Process Mapping, SQL, Change & Optimisation, Training, Data and Operational Systems

The Opportunity

We build ERP software that helps ambitious UK businesses run their day-to-day operations – from orders, stock, purchasing and warehouse processes to fulfilment, reporting, finance and customer service.

Customers don’t just need software configured. They need someone who can understand how their business works, guide them through change and make sure the system genuinely improves how they operate.

As a Senior ERP Consultant, you’ll work directly with both new and established customers. You’ll deliver implementations, improve existing setups, educate users, solve operational problems and make sure customers see the value of the system.

You’ll be the trusted expert on the ground – running discovery sessions, mapping business processes, challenging assumptions, configuring practical solutions, supporting go-lives and helping users build confidence.

This is a small, agile and fast-moving software business, so this isn’t a narrow “caretaker” role.

You’ll get involved beyond the traditional boundaries of implementation, helping shape how projects are delivered, how the product develops and how customers are supported.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Delivering ERP implementation projects across different industries.
• Leading optimisation, improvement and change projects within existing customer environments.
• Understanding customer workflows and translating them into practical ERP solutions.
• Running discovery, requirements gathering, process mapping, training and go-live support.
• Configuring solutions and supporting customers through implementation and adoption.
• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and day-to-day users.
• Challenging customer assumptions constructively when there’s a better way to achieve the outcome.
• Using SQL and data investigation to support configuration, troubleshooting and validation.
• Working closely with Support, Product and Development to resolve issues and improve delivery.
• Feeding customer insight back into the business to improve the product, process and customer experience.
• Helping shape how implementation and Customer Success are delivered as the business grows.

About You

This isn’t a role for someone who has simply administered an ERP platform internally. You’ll be an experienced ERP consultant who understands implementation, operational processes and what it takes to guide customers successfully through change.

You’ll bring:

• At least five years’ experience implementing, consulting on or advising around ERP systems.
• Proven experience delivering successful ERP implementations and strong customer outcomes.
• Experience improving, optimising or leading change within existing ERP customer environments.
• Strong knowledge of processes such as stock, purchasing, order management, fulfilment, finance and reporting.
• Solid SQL and technical capability, with the confidence to investigate data and get under the hood when required.
• Experience running discovery, requirements gathering and business process mapping.
• Confidence training users and working with non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge, guide and influence.
• The ability to bring structure and calm when customers are under pressure.
• A practical, proactive mindset and willingness to get involved wherever the customer or wider business needs you.
• The flexibility to travel extensively across the UK and stay away from home regularly.

What This Role Isn’t

This isn’t a desk-only ERP configuration role.

You won’t spend your working life sitting remotely and configuring tickets somebody else has scoped.

You’ll work with real businesses, real operational pressure and sometimes messy problems. You’ll need the technical confidence to investigate issues properly, alongside the commercial judgement to understand what the customer is really trying to achieve.

Equally, this isn’t purely a new implementation role. A significant part of your value will come from returning to established customers, identifying where they could be getting more from their ERP environment and leading the improvements needed to make that happen.

The Travel

This is a genuinely field-based, customer-facing position.

You’ll travel extensively across the UK to work directly with customers, including regular overnight stays away from home.

If you enjoy getting out from behind the screen, understanding customer operations first-hand and becoming their trusted ERP expert, it could be exactly what you’re looking for.

Why Join?

• £55,000 – £65,000 salary.
• Car allowance plus additional company benefits.
• Genuine ownership of customer outcomes.
• Variety across implementations, optimisation and operational problem-solving.
• Direct access to leadership within a small, agile business.
• The opportunity to influence project delivery, product development and Customer Success.
• A role where your commercial, operational and technical expertise are equally valued.
• The chance to see the real-world impact of the solutions you deliver.

Your Experience May Include
Senior ERP Consultant, ERP Implementation Consultant, ERP Software Consultant, ERP Functional Consultant, Business Systems Consultant, Implementation Consultant, ERP Application Consultant, ERP Customer Success Consultant or Senior Software Consultant.

Ready to Own the Outcome?

If you enjoy getting close to customers, understanding how their businesses really operate and turning ERP technology into measurable improvements, we’d love to meet you.

Bring your ERP expertise
, SQL capability, commercial judgement and willingness to get out there with customers – and help make sure powerful software delivers powerful results.

Job Description: Customer Success and Support Analyst at everyLIFE Technologies

Salary: £27,000 per annum, with salary reviewed on successful completion of 6-month probationary period. Plus paid on-call.

Position Type: Permanent
Location: Hybrid: Farnborough head office and Remote
Benefits: 25 days holiday, private medical cover with Vitality, life insurance, company pension scheme, Cycle-scheme, free non-fiction book scheme, earlier finish ‘Chill Friday’
Working Hours: Full time
Start date: ASAP
Reporting to: Head of Customer Experience

We are rapidly expanding our team and looking for a full-time Customer Success and Support Analyst to support our growing customer base.
The Customer Support team are a multi-disciplined, technical and customer-driven team delivering excellent service.

About the role

This is a fast-paced, customer-facing support role where you will work across multiple channels, with a strong focus on telephone-based support.
You will spend a significant portion of your time speaking directly with customers, helping them resolve issues in real time, guiding them through workflows, and ensuring they get the most value from our products. Confidence and clarity on the phone are essential.
You will:

Deliver high-quality customer support across email, in-product chat, and telephone, with phone support as a core part of the role
Confidently handle a high volume of inbound and outbound customer calls, including troubleshooting issues and guiding users step-by-step through solutions
Ensure customers receive an easy, memorable, and valued service across all touchpoints
Seek to understand how customers use our products, and proactively offer guidance to help them get the best value
Troubleshoot issues live with customers, often in real-time over the phone
Maintain an accurate record of enquiries with all relevant information within Salesforce to ensure timely and accurate resolution of issues and customer queries
Provide emergency support out of hours on a rotational basis (after initial onboarding period)
Use software tools to thoroughly investigate, test and replicate customer issues to identify causes of problems
Work with connected technology providers to effectively implement integrated solutions or solve problems affecting customers
Research and interpret application log files and user behaviour to help diagnose issues
Document and share workarounds or key steps via our Help and Support Centre and with wider customer-facing teams
Use software such as Intercom, Aircall, Confluence, Jira, Kibana, Postman and Bugfender, as well as Microsoft suite of products

You have:

Proven experience in a customer-facing role with regular telephone-based support (e.g. contact centre, service desk, or high-volume support environment)
At least 1–2 years’ experience handling customer support via telephone in a fast-paced environment
Strong verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly, control conversations, and explain technical concepts clearly over the phone
Experience handling challenging conversations and confidently de-escalating frustrated customers
The skillset to follow up with customers and deliver timely updates on tickets and cases
Experience of working in a high-performing, busy team
A logical approach, with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
Initiative to resolve customer issues and provide an exceptional service
The ability to manage a varied workload
A desire to increase your technical knowledge
Willingness to contribute ideas, innovation and team spirit

You may have:

Experience or interest in the Care industry
An inclination to keep up with developments in technology and social care
Experience using Salesforce, Intercom and Jira
An ambition to continuously grow and develop

Why join everyLIFE?

Be part of a team that is transforming the UK care industry
. If you thrive supporting customers, enjoy building relationships and making a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you!
Our mission is to create effective tools and services that release the potential of care teams.

Established in 2014, everyLIFE Technologies is a fast-growth SaaS provider primarily to the UK social care market. We exist to support care services to be the best that they can be.
We design, build, release, manage and support software and mobile applications that are crucial parts of the care being given to tens of thousands of people across the UK. We must get it right, every day!
Our ideal teammates are thoughtful, humble, curious, achievement-oriented professionals who can both zoom into the details and zoom out to embrace the big picture. We are customer-led and always aim for the highest standard. We believe in being transparent in all our dealings; acting fairly, openly, and honestly in everything we do.

Please note that we are only able to accept applicants with the right to live and work in the UK without the need for sponsorship. If you are on a visa and interested in applying for this role, please contact us for further information.

If you have any questions, or to apply with your CV, please email
hr@everylifetechnologies.com
Due to the high volume of applicants that we receive, we cannot always guarantee that you will receive a response.

new_jobs.description:
See it differently - Early Careers at Arup

See it differently

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.

The Opportunity

The Graduate Computational Urban Designer would contribute across two connected workstreams in our team.

Strategic Masterplanning & Advisory:
Masterplanning and urban design studies
Research, analysis and visualisation
Development frameworks and strategic plans
Community and stakeholder engagement support
Bid and proposal support
Urban InForm:
Project deployment and set-up
Computational modelling support
Testing and quality assurance with Arup domain experts
Development of re-usable digital workflows and libraries
User support, onboarding and training materials
Production of client demonstrations and project value stories
You will be aligned but not limited to the following duties -
Masterplanning and urban design studies
Computational modelling support- specific to Arup's Urban Inform
Development of re-usable digital workflows and libraries
Production of client demonstrations and project value stories

https://www.arup.com/services/digital-solutions/inform/

Urban InForm Demo Page: https://inform.arup.com/project/51531235-4b8a-4086-9c7b-3693639f0918?view=inform&analysisId=6a8db621ee0e34b9f7daf2b8

https://arup.sharepoint.com/:p:/s/ParametricMassing/IQCRkb7STyU9R5XhQRRMoypEAYno7fhB8ZyUNq4NUJf04pM?CID=889bb523-ce08-d181-2a05-b289f9c220c4

Is this role right for you?

For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:

A Master's-level degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, such as Computer Science (including Cybersecurity), Architecture, Urban Design or Urban Planning.

Parametric and computational design: Rhino and Grasshopper Ability to build, test and maintain reusable scripts, definitions and workflows Understanding of spatial parameters, design rules, optimisation and scenario testing.
GIS, spatial data and mapping: ArcGIS, QGIS and/or FME Spatial data preparation, cleaning, geoprocessing and analysis Ability to work with site, land use, movement, environmental and socio-economic datasets.
Data analytics and visualisation: Excel, Power BI and/or similar dashboarding tools Ability to interpret datasets and translate outputs into clear project insights Basic understanding of data structures, KPIs and performance metrics Urban modelling and scenario testing: Experience supporting masterplan option testing, density studies, accessibility analysis, land-use mix, capacity studies and climate/sustainability metrics

Ability to connect design inputs with evidence-based outputs for client decision-making

Coding and scripting: Python would be particularly useful, especially for automation, data processing and linking design tools with external datasets Familiarity with APIs, notebooks or low-code/no-code workflows would be beneficial
CAD and design production: AutoCAD, Rhino and potentially Revit awareness Ability to translate between technical outputs and spatial/design drawings
Graphic communication and client-facing outputs: Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop Clear visual storytelling for reports, bids, client demonstrations and training materials
AI-supported workflows: Interest in AI-assisted design, research, coding, data interpretation and visualisation Ability to test AI-enabled workflows responsibly and document their value, risks and limitations

To Be Considered For a Graduate Opportunity, Your Application Must Include a Copy Of Your Academic Transcript And Meet The Following Criteria

Full working rights in the country of application
No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role
Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

In order for your application to be considered for this role, please upload evidence of work, for example your sample portfolio or website link. The document must be in PDF format and no larger than 20MB. Please use image compression and vector drawings where possible to keep the file size down without sacrificing quality. To upload your sample portfolio please add it within the 'supporting documents' section of your application.

Alongside your qualifications and experience, we look for the following core attributes:
Changemakers: You care about sustainable development and want to see your work make a genuine difference.
Innovative minds: You think critically, ask hard questions, and are genuinely open to new approaches.
Growth seekers: You are curious, actively seek feedback, and look for ways to keep developing.

Adaptable adventurers: You are comfortable with uncertainty and adapt readily as projects and priorities evolve.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.

Eligibility

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.

What we offer you

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.

We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Next Steps

We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact UKEarlyCareersRecruitment@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

As a Disability Confident Level 2 Employer in the UK, we will strive for one third of all our interview places to be allocated to candidates who have disclosed they are disability confident and best meet the requirements of the role.
